cells.name: overview
cells.content:
# Fontaine overview

Event cells read `log_entries` and work on both backends. Metric cells read `measures` and are native-only: micromegas drops OTLP histograms, so the guardian latency cell is empty over OTLP, and OTLP sums are cumulative, so `SUM(value)` over them disagrees with native. Cost and token cells exclude the estimated guardian spend, which has its own cell.

cells.name: cost_by_session_model
cells.sql:
SELECT process_id,
       property_get(properties, 'model') AS model,
       property_get(properties, 'query_source') AS query_source,
       SUM(value) AS usd
FROM measures
WHERE name = 'fontaine.cost.usage' AND property_get(properties, 'estimated') IS NULL
GROUP BY process_id, property_get(properties, 'model'), property_get(properties, 'query_source')
ORDER BY usd DESC

cells.name: tokens_by_session_model
cells.sql:
SELECT process_id,
       property_get(properties, 'model') AS model,
       property_get(properties, 'query_source') AS query_source,
       property_get(properties, 'type') AS type,
       SUM(value) AS tokens
FROM measures
WHERE name = 'fontaine.token.usage' AND property_get(properties, 'estimated') IS NULL
GROUP BY process_id, property_get(properties, 'model'), property_get(properties, 'query_source'), property_get(properties, 'type')
ORDER BY tokens DESC

cells.name: estimated_guardian_spend
cells.sql:
SELECT process_id,
       property_get(properties, 'model') AS model,
       name,
       SUM(value) AS estimated
FROM measures
WHERE name IN ('fontaine.cost.usage', 'fontaine.token.usage') AND property_get(properties, 'estimated') = 'true'
GROUP BY process_id, property_get(properties, 'model'), name
ORDER BY estimated DESC

cells.name: api_requests
cells.sql:
SELECT property_get(properties, 'model') AS model,
       property_get(properties, 'query_source') AS query_source,
       COUNT(*) AS requests,
       SUM(CAST(property_get(properties, 'input_tokens') AS DOUBLE)) AS input_tokens,
       SUM(CAST(property_get(properties, 'output_tokens') AS DOUBLE)) AS output_tokens,
       SUM(CAST(property_get(properties, 'cost_usd') AS DOUBLE)) AS usd
FROM log_entries
WHERE target = 'fontaine::telemetry' AND split_part(msg, ' ', 1) = 'api_request'
GROUP BY property_get(properties, 'model'), property_get(properties, 'query_source')
ORDER BY requests DESC

cells.name: guardian_latency
cells.sql:
SELECT property_get(properties, 'model') AS model,
       COUNT(*) AS calls,
       approx_percentile_cont(value, 0.5) AS p50_ms,
       approx_percentile_cont(value, 0.95) AS p95_ms
FROM measures
WHERE name = 'fontaine.guardian.latency'
GROUP BY property_get(properties, 'model')
ORDER BY calls DESC

cells.name: fail_closed_by_reason
cells.sql:
SELECT property_get(properties, 'fail_closed_reason') AS reason, COUNT(*) AS denials
FROM log_entries
WHERE target = 'fontaine::telemetry' AND split_part(msg, ' ', 1) = 'tool_decision' AND property_get(properties, 'fail_closed_reason') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY property_get(properties, 'fail_closed_reason')
ORDER BY denials DESC

cells.name: decision_mix
cells.sql:
SELECT property_get(properties, 'tier') AS tier,
       property_get(properties, 'decision') AS decision,
       SUM(value) AS decisions
FROM measures
WHERE name = 'fontaine.tool_decision.count'
GROUP BY property_get(properties, 'tier'), property_get(properties, 'decision')
ORDER BY decisions DESC

cells.name: screen_outcomes
cells.sql:
SELECT property_get(properties, 'outcome') AS outcome, SUM(value) AS calls
FROM measures
WHERE name = 'fontaine.screen.count'
GROUP BY property_get(properties, 'outcome')
ORDER BY calls DESC

cells.name: screen_risk_distribution
cells.sql:
SELECT floor(CAST(property_get(properties, 'screen.risk') AS DOUBLE) * 10) / 10 AS risk_from,
       COUNT(*) AS decisions
FROM log_entries
WHERE target = 'fontaine::telemetry' AND split_part(msg, ' ', 1) = 'tool_decision' AND property_get(properties, 'screen.risk') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY floor(CAST(property_get(properties, 'screen.risk') AS DOUBLE) * 10) / 10
ORDER BY risk_from

cells.name: tool_results
cells.sql:
SELECT property_get(properties, 'tool_name') AS tool_name,
       COUNT(*) AS calls,
       AVG(CASE WHEN property_get(properties, 'success') = 'true' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS success_rate,
       approx_percentile_cont(CAST(property_get(properties, 'duration_ms') AS DOUBLE), 0.5) AS p50_ms,
       approx_percentile_cont(CAST(property_get(properties, 'duration_ms') AS DOUBLE), 0.95) AS p95_ms
FROM log_entries
WHERE target = 'fontaine::telemetry' AND split_part(msg, ' ', 1) = 'tool_result'
GROUP BY property_get(properties, 'tool_name')
ORDER BY calls DESC

cells.name: subagent_lifecycle
cells.sql:
SELECT property_get(properties, 'event') AS event, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM log_entries
WHERE target = 'fontaine::telemetry' AND split_part(msg, ' ', 1) = 'subagent'
GROUP BY property_get(properties, 'event')
ORDER BY events DESC

cells.name: api_errors
cells.sql:
SELECT property_get(properties, 'error_class') AS class,
       property_get(properties, 'status_code') AS status_code,
       property_get(properties, 'query_source') AS query_source,
       COUNT(*) AS errors
FROM log_entries
WHERE target = 'fontaine::telemetry' AND split_part(msg, ' ', 1) = 'api_error'
GROUP BY property_get(properties, 'error_class'), property_get(properties, 'status_code'), property_get(properties, 'query_source')
ORDER BY errors DESC

cells.name: internal_errors
cells.sql:
SELECT property_get(properties, 'class') AS class, COUNT(*) AS errors
FROM log_entries
WHERE target = 'fontaine::telemetry' AND split_part(msg, ' ', 1) = 'internal_error'
GROUP BY property_get(properties, 'class')
ORDER BY errors DESC
